# AudioCraft source snapshot

This directory contains the AudioCraft source snapshot used by the
Auralink VMM service.

## Source status

- Original project: Meta AudioCraft
- Exact Git commit: unavailable in the current server copy
- Archived from the historical Auralink server environment
- Local source path on the original server:
  `/root/autodl-tmp/auralink/VMM/audiocraft`

Only the source and configuration files required by the VMM service are
included. Build products, caches, tests, sample audio, model weights and
runtime outputs are excluded.

See `LICENSE` and `LICENSE_weights` for licensing information.
